profile.title: Profile
profile.name: Name
profile.pictureNote: Your picture comes from your sign-in provider.
profile.regionBody: How rooster speaks to you and shows dates and times.
profile.timezoneHint: “Today” and due times follow this time zone.
profile.dateFormatSwedish: Swedish always shows the day first.

security.sessionsBody: Sign out anywhere you no longer use rooster. That device is signed out on its next request.

general.title: General
general.name: Organisation name
general.personalNote: This is your personal organisation. Only you can see it, and its name can’t be changed.
general.ownersOnly: Only owners can change these settings.

members.title: Members
members.removeBody: Their tasks here become unassigned and their groups are deleted.
members.lastOwner: You’re the only owner. Make someone else an owner before you change your own role.
members.lastOwnerError: Every organisation needs at least one owner.

invites.title: Invites
invites.description: Invite by email or share a link. Until email delivery is set up, both give you a link to copy.
invites.personal: Personal organisations can’t be shared. Create a new organisation to work with others.
invites.createFailed: Couldn’t create the invite. Try again.
invites.createdEmail: Invite for {email} created. Send them this link:
invites.createdLink: Link created. Anyone with it can join until it expires.
invites.copyFailed: Couldn’t copy the link. Select it and copy it manually.
invites.multiUseCount: {count, plural, =0 {Reusable · not used yet} one {Reusable · used once} other {Reusable · used # times}}
invites.descriptionEmail: Invite by email or share a link.
invites.sentNote: The invite is on its way to {email}. You can also share this link:

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.personal: Your personal organisation can’t be deleted or left.
danger.leaveBody: You lose access to its tasks. Your groups here are deleted and your tasks become unassigned.
danger.leaveSoleOwner: You’re the only owner. Make someone else an owner before you leave.
danger.leaveConfirmBody: Leave {name}? You need a new invite to come back.
danger.deleteBody: Deletes all tasks, groups and tags for every member. This can’t be undone.
danger.deleteFailed: Couldn’t delete the organisation. Try again.

error.saveFailed: Couldn’t save. Check your connection and try again.

behaviour.swipeBody: On phones, swipe a task right or left to act on it at once.

data.exportBody: Download your groups, tasks, subtasks and tags in this organisation.
data.offline: You’re offline. Export and Trash need a connection.
data.trashBody: Deleted tasks stay here for 30 days. Trash is shared by everyone in the organisation.
data.trashFailed: Couldn’t load the Trash. Try again.
data.confirm: Delete for good? This can’t be undone.
data.failed: Couldn’t do that. Check your connection and try again.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.body: Choose how you hear about changes, per event and channel. You never get notified about your own changes.

type.assigned: A task is assigned to me
type.comment: Someone comments on a task I follow
type.completed: Someone completes a task I created
type.due_changed: Someone changes the due date of my task

notifications.reminderTimeHint: When the due reminder is on, a push lists the tasks due that day.
notifications.digestTimeHint: An email with what’s due today, what’s overdue and what’s new in your inbox.
notifications.emailModeHint: Every 15 minutes collects the notifications in one email.

push.title: Push on this device
push.body: Get notifications on this device even when rooster is closed. Turn push on for each phone or computer separately.
push.on: Push is on for this device.
push.turnOn: Turn on push for this device
push.enabled: Push is on for this device
push.disabled: Push is off for this device
push.enableFailed: Couldn’t turn on push. Try again.
push.unsupportedService: This browser’s push service isn’t supported, so push can’t be turned on here. Try Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari.
push.blockedBody: Your browser blocks notifications from rooster. Allow them in the site settings (the icon next to the address), then reload this page.
push.blockedIos: Allow notifications for rooster in the Settings app under Notifications, then open rooster again.
push.iosBody: Add rooster to your Home Screen first; push works only in the installed app.
push.unsupported: Push notifications aren’t available in this browser.
push.testFailed: Couldn’t send the test notification. Try again.
push.testGone: That device is no longer subscribed and was removed. Turn push on there again.

dev.devices: Push on this device and devices
dev.pushStates: Push states: blocked, iOS hint, unsupported, loading
